sole_source_requirement_and_vendor_uniqu.description: Primary solicitation or contract input text for FAR 6.302 / FAR 8.405-6 Sole-Source Justification & Approval (J&A / LSJ) Drafter API.
sole_source_requirement_and_vendor_uniqu.example: REQUIREMENT: Bridge & Follow-On Sole-Source Modification for USAF Tactical C2 Cloud Mesh & Proprietary Cross-Domain Guard (36 Months, $18.5M). Proposed Contractor: Aegis Tactical Cyber LLC (SBA Certified 8(a) / SDVOSB, CAGE 9K4L2). Uniqueness Rationale: Aegis developed the NSA NCDSMO-accredited Cross-Domain Solution (CDS) FPGA filter and Zero-Trust tactical mesh under SBIR Phase II FA8750-24-C-0091. Transitioning to another vendor would require an 18-to-24 month NSA recertification delay and $11.4M in duplicative non-recurring engineering (NRE) that cannot be recovered through competition.
